skill.summary: Automatisation de la création de modèles 3D via Meshy.ai. Utilisez cette compétence pour transformer du texte ou des images en modèles 3D (STL/OBJ), applique...

latestVersion.changelog:
v1.0.0 — Initial Release

* First version of the automated 3D model generator powered by Meshy.ai.
* Enables conversion of text or images into fully generated 3D models (STL/OBJ formats).
* Automatic AI-based texture generation applied to generated models.
* Complete workflow included: model generation, advanced AI texturing, and final 3D file export.
* Recommended configuration tables provided for optimal results using the Meshy-5 model.
* Prompt and input image optimization guidelines included to improve generation quality.
